title: Retain reproducible full-domain coupled frame screen (numerical, no new κ)
body:
PR4994 exposes 1,339 flexible contacts but leaves their coupled optimization open. This follow-up retains a complete one-hot screen over all 4,684 marginal subspaces, with 9,276 binary variables, 9,432 rows and explicit mapped-neighbor compatibility constraints. The objective is the fixed child-price point `a = 15108879/5000000000`.

HiGHS returned the original source: zero changed contacts and the unchanged paid profile in both orientations. It reported `kOptimal` after one branch-and-bound node. The returned assignment was checked with exact graph constraints, chronological frames, all 632 independent-input endpoints and complete paid counts. **The numerical solver status is not an exact global optimality certificate and no new κ is claimed.**

The optional runner, pinned highspy/numpy requirements, MPS model, returned node values, source-bound run metadata and frozen solver report are retained under `research/carried-warp-frame-intervals/discovery/`. It writes to a separate output directory. The registered proof replay remains standard-library-only and does not install or invoke the solver. Forward/backward variable contacts are aligned by ordinal, with each direction's fixed owned-cell contacts retained independently. The solver report has only trailing whitespace removed.

Validation on final head `be656882128732110c00d08ceff265e71bece0f9`:

- Portable numerical runner reproduces the source unchanged and passes exact candidate revalidation in both orientations.
- The exported runner also passes under `-OO` without Git, using the declared pinned external solver installation.
- Registered standard-library proof replay and metadata/source pins pass; its thirteen controls remain intact.
- All 23 package/input files pass committed-byte preflight and export integrity; `git diff --check` passes.

Canonical main `f259dabc7d70e0db8d6d36bfda888f008bbfecc1` is merged into this branch. Source modules and all seven scientific live inputs remain unchanged. The shallow checkout's full-history preflight was not rerun. Publication overlap covered 304 open PRs and 4,112 discussion records with complete remote pagination at 2026-10-23 06:21 UTC; sparse local note coverage remains incomplete.

The next question now asks for a checkable exact certificate or a named changed native premise, rather than another copy of this numerical scan. Existing interval proofs and selected results are unchanged. Parent PR4994 and Dugongue/PR4971, Cao Yifan, Cinna Davis and the retained native/compiler lineage keep their attribution. The official HiGHS interface/examples are linked in the discovery README. Prepared by 1337isnot1337 with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance, without subagents. Apache-2.0.
